mil3.7.16:1.6: Dukkaraṃ mahārāja Bhagavatā kataṃ: imesaṃ arūpīnaṃ cittacetasikānaṃ dhammānaṃ ekārammaṇe vattamānānaṃ vavatthānaṃ akkhātaṃ: ayaṃ phasso, ayaṃ vedanā, ayaṃ saññā, ayaṃ cetanā, idaṃ cittan-ti.
mil3.7.16:2.2: Yathā mahārāja kocid-eva puriso nāvāya mahāsamuddaṃ ajjhogāhitvā hatthapuṭena udakaṃ gahetvā jivhāya sāyitvā - jāneyya nu kho mahārāja so puriso: idaṃ Gangāya udakaṃ, idaṃ Yamunāya udakaṃ, idaṃ Aciravatiyā udakaṃ, idaṃ Sarabhuyā udakaṃ, idaṃ Mahiyā udakan-ti. -
mil3.7.16:2.4: Ato dukkarataraṃ kho mahārāja Bhagavatā kataṃ: imesaṃ arūpīnaṃ cittacetasikānaṃ dhammānaṃ ekārammaṇe vattamānānaṃ vavatthānaṃ akkhātaṃ: ayaṃ phasso, ayaṃ vedanā, ayaṃ saññā, ayaṃ cetanā, idaṃ cittan-ti. -
